[Sent Sticker] Concept: The sticker displays three frames, each featuring a man who resembles actor Leonardo DiCaprio, wearing a white polo shirt. In the first frame, he smiles broadly with his eyes squinted. The second frame shows him with a confident smirk, pointing directly towards the viewer. The third frame captures him smiling and looking to his left. All frames suggest an affluent outdoor setting, possibly a yacht or waterfront, with blurred backgrounds. The overall tone is one of leisure, confidence, and amusement.
